name: Overseas Educational Loan Scheme
benefit: - The loan amount will be provided up to ₹20,00,000/- at a zero interest rate.
_eligibility_text: 1. The student should be a resident of Karnataka State. 1. The student should belong to a minority community (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh and Parsi). 1. The student should have secured at least 60% marks in the previous year. 1. The student should have received an offer letter from a foreign university. 1. Loans will be provided only on mortgage of property (building/land) to the corporation. The value of the property should not be less than the loan amount. 1. The students who have not received a scholarship from the Directorate of Minorities.
